data.title: bn-2a5: Add semantic sprite atlas and live-map inspection
data.description: Review semantic atlas ownership/annotation/report correctness, authored-vs-live map snapshot semantics, playtest artifact safety, backward compatibility, tests, and docs.

data.body: P2 correctness: `string_param(...).unwrap_or("authored")` conflates an omitted/null source with a present value of the wrong JSON type. Repro: after `load_cart`, `map_dump` with `{"source":17,"region":"0,0,1,1"}` succeeds and returns the authored cell instead of `-32602`. This makes malformed callers silently inspect the wrong state, which is particularly risky for live-map acceptance evidence. Please distinguish missing/null from a present non-string, reject the latter, and add a regression for all three map RPC verbs (a shared `map_snapshot` test is sufficient).

P2 reliability: `sprite atlas` unconditionally draws each anchor, but the cart contract explicitly permits anchors outside sprite bounds and parses any `i32`. `draw_anchor` computes `anchor.0 * zoom` / `anchor.1 * zoom` in `i32`, so a valid declaration such as `anchor=2147483647,0` panics in debug builds (and wraps in release). Unlike the older opt-in `--anchor` views, every atlas invocation hits this path. Please make the anchor math overflow-safe (for example calculate/clamp in i64 before clipping) and cover extreme legal anchors so atlas remains a report tool rather than crashing on metadata it should diagnose.

data.reason: Request changes: reject non-string map RPC source values instead of silently selecting authored state, and make unconditional atlas anchor rendering safe for the full legal i32 anchor domain. Focused tests otherwise pass.

data.body: Fixed: present non-string source values now return -32602 for every map RPC verb; missing/null still default to authored. Added shared regression coverage across render, dump, and lint.

Fixed: atlas palette analysis no longer performs unnecessary anchor-relative arithmetic, and anchor drawing widens the full legal i32 domain to i64 before applying zoom/clipping. Added an i32::MAX/i32::MIN atlas regression.

data.reason: Fixed in 2979620 and verified by exact regression plus full map_view suite.
Fixed in 2979620 with i64 anchor math and verified against i32 MIN/MAX.
Approved after re-review of 2979620: both P2 findings are fixed with direct regressions; affected integration suites pass.
